Travel Request Form (TL Form) Guidance

From the ORA eTraining module "Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement" (lesson 5 of 8).
MSU Travel Authorization Forms
Completing a Travel Request (TL) form is a mandatory step in the university’s travel process. It ensures that Morgan State University is aware of travel plans, enabling proper documentation and coordination. Submitting a TL form also activates necessary insurance coverage for MSU travelers and allows departments to address any coverage considerations for faculty traveling during the academic year. Please review the guidance below for best practices on completing your travel requests.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Completing a Travel Request (TL) Form
Grant-Funded Travel must utilize the ORA Travel DocuSign forms found here . All Out-of-State travel requires an authorized TL form.
sm
Travel Advances
If needed, travel advances must be requested no less than 30 days prior to travel. Please review guidance on this from the Office of the Comptroller here .
Amended Travel
If you are submitting a corrected/amended travel form please include the previously approved travel authorization number (TL#) here.
Traveler Information
Please enter all traveler information here.
Email Copy
There is room to add a second email address on a separate line, if someone other than the traveler needs a copy of the completed TL form.
Method of Travel
Select the primary method of travel used on the trip. Flight and train tickets should be booked through Globetrotter .
International Travel
Traveling outside of the US is generally not allowed on grants without explicit permission from the sponsor. If allowable, international travel requires approval from the EVP for Finance and Management.
Banner Index
The 6-digit code requested here should match your project's Banner index. This number is shared by the Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) team during initial award setup.
Banner Account Code
This five digit number refers to the Banner account code used for travel expenses. They are as follows: 04010: In State Routine Travel 04020: In State Conference 04030: Out of State Routine Travel 04040: Out of State Conference 04041: Out of Country Travel
MSU ID
Enter the MSU ID of the traveler.
Total Estimated Costs
In this column the initiator should detail all expected costs of the travel. It is best to pad the flight cost slightly to allow for potential cost increases during travel-form processing. Meal per diem rates can be found on the Comptroller's site here . Per diem is based on travel times. For example, if you leave for the trip around 1 pm you wouldn't be able to claim breakfast per diem that day. "Other Transportation" would cover costs such as mileage, tolls, parking, and taxi.
P-Card or Purchase Order Expenses
Any expense paid for by p-card or purchase order should be accounted for in this column. These charges will reduce the total funds held in column #3 (Total to be Encumbered).
Total Encumbered
The ORA Grant-funded Travel Request (TL) Form will automatically calculate the amount that needs to be encumbered in this 3 rd column. Funds encumbered will be set aside, i.e. “committed”, for the Banner Index listed on this form in Pool Level 04. The total amount set aside, $1,028, includes $400 for airfare and the remaining balance for meal and ground transportation reimbursements upon your return. Figures in this column should never be negative.

Additional TL Form Information
Form Submission Timeline
Travel requests should be submitted no later than 30 days prior to departure for domestic travel and 90 days for international travel. A travel form requires multiple approvals and review from various departments on campus to include your department's administration, ORA, and the MSU Travel Office.
Required Supporting Documentation
When submitting a travel request you need to provide supporting documentation that matches your estimated expenses. Such required documents may include: Hotel Booking Confirmation Conference Registration fee receipt/invoice Mileage Map (if using personal vehicle) Notice of Award (for international travel)
In-State Travel Guidance
Not all in-state travel will require a travel authorization form. However, you will need to submit one if: Hotel/Lodging expenses are expected for the trip A travel advance will be needed You need to use Globetrotter for a train ticket or other transportation The traveler is a non-MSU (external) individual using Globetrotter for accommodations In-State travel authorization forms are subject to the EVP for Finance and Management's review. Washington DC is considered "in-state." Lodging is an allowable cost if the meeting/conference destination is at least 40 miles from MSU campus.
Meal Per Diem
Per diem rates for meals can vary widely by destination. The standard rates for in-state travel, and travel to lower-cost destinations, are listed on the Comptoller's page here . The current rates are: $15 for Breakfast $18 for Lunch $30 for Dinner High-cost metropolitan areas such as NYC or Miami will typically have a greater per diem allowance than the standard meal allowance listed on the Comptroller's Travel page. Consider the per diem rates found here when planning a trip out of state to ensure you utilize the appropriate rate. Per diem rates change annually so be sure you are using current figures.
